parameters.query: SELECT o.id AS onboarding_id,c.primary_contact_email,ic.configuration->>'user_uri' AS user_uri FROM app.onboardings o JOIN app.clients c ON c.id=o.client_id JOIN app.integration_connections ic ON ic.provider='calendly' AND ic.health='healthy' LEFT JOIN app.kickoff_bookings kb ON kb.onboarding_id=o.id WHERE o.status='READY_FOR_KICKOFF' AND kb.id IS NULL;

parameters.jsCode: const ready=$('Load Ready Onboardings').all().map(i=>i.json);const event=$('Split Scheduled Events').item.json;const invitees=$json.collection??[];let onboarding,invitee;for(const candidate of ready){invitee=invitees.find(i=>String(i.tracking?.utm_content??'')===String(candidate.onboarding_id))??invitees.find(i=>String(i.email??'').toLowerCase()===String(candidate.primary_contact_email).toLowerCase());if(invitee){onboarding=candidate;break;}}if(!onboarding||!invitee)return[];const eventId=String(event.uri??'').split('/').pop();const location=event.location??{};const meetingUrl=String(location.join_url??location.location??'');const payload={onboarding_id:String(onboarding.onboarding_id),event_id:eventId,starts_at:String(event.start_time),meeting_url:meetingUrl};return[{json:{...payload,payload_base64:Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload)).toString('base64')}}];

parameters.query: WITH input AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1,'base64'),'UTF8')::jsonb p) SELECT app.record_kickoff_booking((p->>'onboarding_id')::uuid,p->>'event_id',(p->>'starts_at')::timestamptz,p->>'meeting_url') AS result FROM input;
